title: Nothing is re-sent to QuickBooks at release
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Trucks Hill 2 on the production test account.
  • The production test organization is connected to QuickBooks Online. Before the release reached production, its QB Unexported report and the QuickBooks invoice list were captured (screenshots).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the QB Unexported report.
  2. In QuickBooks, open the invoice list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it holds the same records as before the release, and none was added by the release.
  • Step 2: no invoice was re-sent or changed by the release (same count and same last-changed dates as captured).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-N1: “Nothing is moved, re-dated or re-sent to QuickBooks at release.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
